Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful context on your evaluation goals. Quick recap and a couple of next steps so we can lock a short product walkthrough (30 minutes) with your engineering lead included.

- Key constraints: PII handling, regional isolation in us-east, predictable per-token cost targets
- Success metric: proof-of-concept within 6 weeks and cost baseline for 100k tokens/day

Proposed next step: 30-minute walkthrough/demo with our Solutions Engineer to cover architecture, integration approach, and a quick live run-through. Please pick the slot that works best — I can also adjust if needed.

Three initial options (all ET):
1) Tue, Jun 5 — 10:00–10:30
2) Wed, Jun 6 — 14:00–14:30
3) Thu, Jun 7 — 09:00–09:30

If you prefer a later block on the 7th, tell me what afternoon window works and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: redwood-brief-1pager.pdf (one-pager), and I’ll send an invite once we pick a slot. HubSpot link to the record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

Thanks — looking forward to bringing Jordan into the session to answer the deep integration questions.
